div.head: Af 25.1
div.ab: Gif ðeowmon þeowne to nydhæmede genide, bete mid his hyde (alias eowede).
Gif ðeowmon þeowne to nedhæmde genede, bete mid his eowende.
Si seruus seruam ad uiolentum concubitum cogat, testiculos perdat.
Gif ðeowman þeowne to nedhæmde genede, bete mid his eowende.
If a slave rapes a slave, let him compensate with his ?testicles.
If a slave rapes a slave, castration shall be required as compensation.
If a slave rape a slave-woman, he is to pay by suffering castration.
Wenn ein Sklav eine Sklavin zur Nothzucht zwingt, büsse er mit seinem Zeugungsgliede.
If a slave forces a slave woman to intercourse, let him pay with his genitals.
